proposals.proposal: Extend CHK-004 files.modify with packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts, packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts, and packages/main/src/core/config.ts solely to expose finding_runtime_evidence_run and finding_runtime_evidence_verify as real schema-validated, phase-allowlisted CLI commands. Process-fact authority registry changes remain exclusively CHK-005.
proposals.reason: The accepted CHK-004 requirement explicitly mandates real CLI handlers. registry.ts plus handler code alone is not reachable through the production CLI without catalog schema and command/phase policy registration; a test-only registry invocation would not satisfy acceptance.

decision.rationale: Accepted because these three files are the minimal production reachability surface for the already-approved real CLI commands; no new product behavior or process-fact authority is added.

decision.rationale: Independent INIT reviewer proved the immutable CHK-001 RED cannot become GREEN without an equivalent production restructure in packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts. Accept exactly that file for CHK-006; no additional behavior or Story 2/1 scope.

proposals.proposal: Add exactly packages/main/src/core/finding-runtime-evidence.ts and packages/main/src/handlers/finding-runtime-evidence.ts to CHK-006 files.create as public compatibility facades. The core facade must re-export the implemented runtime receipt, verification, execution, and realpath policy contract from core/runtime-evidence-receipt.ts, including a real compatibility export for realpathPolicyDigest. The handler facade must delegate the real finding_runtime_evidence_run and finding_runtime_evidence_verify handler methods and re-export appendRuntimeReceipt as the real append_runtime_receipt compatibility entry from handlers/finding-ledger.ts. Comments or inert string tokens are not acceptable.
proposals.reason: The immutable RED reads only these two named public paths via sourceMaybe at lines 147-148 and classifies runtime.execution_adapter_missing unless its four required contract identifiers are present. Both files are absent. The actual implementations exist in core/runtime-evidence-receipt.ts and handlers/finding-ledger.ts, so two narrow executable re-export/delegation facades make the intended public contract reachable without duplicating semantics or falsifying RED. Adding tokens to registry or comments would be architecturally dishonest.

decision.rationale: Independent INIT reviewer confirmed the immutable RED and accepted architecture require real public runtime-evidence core/handler facades. Accept exactly two facade files, with executable delegation/re-exports only; comments or token-only shims are forbidden.
